# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 19 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 19:2 — "deep things" vs. "profundities" vs. "depths"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "deep things" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "profundities" | Formal, elevated |
| PNEUMA | "depths" | Simple |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "deep things" -- plain and literal.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 19:8 — "make known the counsel of Your truth" vs. "reveal the design" vs. "let him in on the blueprint"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "make known to him the counsel of Your truth" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "reveal to him the design of Your truth" | sod as design |
| PNEUMA | "let him in on the blueprint of Your truth" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted composite: "make known to him the counsel of Your truth." "Blueprint" from PNEUMA is anachronistic.
**Status:** Resolved with composite.

---

## 19:13 — "spread out" vs. "stretched out" vs. "unfurled"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "spread out" | Literal: natah |
| LOGOS | "stretched out" | Standard biblical |
| PNEUMA | "unfurled" | Poetic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "spread out."
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 19:25 — "eternal salvation" vs. "eternal deliverance" vs. "everlasting rescue"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "eternal salvation" | Consistent with Col. 16 |
| LOGOS | "eternal deliverance" | Avoids Christological overtone |
| PNEUMA | "everlasting rescue" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "eternal salvation" -- consistent with Col. 16 ruling.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 19:27 — "day of slaughter" vs. "day of slaughter" vs. "day of massacre"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "day of slaughter" | Consistent |
| LOGOS | "day of slaughter" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "day of massacre" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "day of slaughter" -- consistent with Col. 16 ruling.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 19:** 5
